inlines.v: AP'PIAN, adjective Designating something that belongs to Appius, particularly a way from Rome through Capua to Brundusium, now Brindisi, constructed by Appius Claudius adjective R. 441. It is more than 330 miles in length, formed of hard stone squared, and so wide as to admit two carriages abreast.
